{{Quote|Most honored Count, Skytop Station is fully active! Only my contacts in the communications cartel could make such a marvel possible.|[[Po Nudo/Legends|Po Nudo]] to [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Prelude">''[[The Clone Wars: Prelude]]''</ref>}}
The '''Hyper-Communications Cartel''' was a faction of the CIS, established by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] to manage its private [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] channels.

==History==
Supported primarily by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] and [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]], who operated private HoloNet alternatives prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Cartel broadcast Confederacy propaganda and anti-Republic news on its signal, presumably under the [[Shadowfeed/Legends|CIS Shadowfeed]] label.

After [[Po Nudo/Legends|Po Nudo]] brought [[Ando/Legends|Ando]] and its loyal systems into the Confederacy fold, he was rewarded with control of the Cartel. The Cartel was responsible for the creation of the [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]] listening post during the war.
